trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use the grade totals to locate unfinished trophies, then filter or search for each remaining target. Earn the other 54 trophies; this platinum is the final award, not a separate activity. Back up your tracker before a cleanup session.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Start with Gone Fishing in the campaign, following the active mission objectives rather than looking for a free-roam fishing activity. Finish the mission before marking this trophy earned; the title of an activity alone is not the requirement.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Work through the campaign missions in order and use the active objective to resume after free roaming. This target is Chapter 1 completion, so an unfinished optional activity is not a reason to delay the chapter. Keep a separate save before story decisions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Resume the campaign after Chapter 1 and finish Chapter 2. If you have several objectives available, prioritize the main story for this trophy and leave a manual save before choices for Actions Speak Louder.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Continue the campaign into Chapter 3 and finish its remaining story objectives. Use a separate save slot before major choices, then check your trophy list after the chapter ends so a missed notification does not send you looking for extra tasks.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 through the campaign objectives. Before pushing toward the final mission, preserve a manual save and review Actions Speak Louder; chapter completion and a particular choice outcome are separate checklist targets.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Make a separate manual save before the campaign finale, then finish the final mission. Check Actions Speak Louder before committing to ending choices so you retain a way to revisit an outcome; the final-mission description itself does not establish a missable trophy.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Look for Breakfast Run among your campaign objectives and complete that named mission. If it is not yet offered, continue earlier story work; there is no reason in the description to search restaurants or repeat unrelated driving jobs.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Reserve a session long enough to finish The Cartel Heist, including any escape objectives still shown on screen. Save before starting so you can return to the setup if needed, and check the trophy list once the mission is over.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Progress the campaign until Child's Play is available, then follow its active objectives through completion. Keep your pre-mission save separate from your roaming save; this trophy asks for mission completion rather than a special performance target.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Follow the campaign to Headliners and finish the named mission. If the trophy remains locked, check whether Headliners is actually complete before replaying unrelated objectives; the description does not demand a medal or optional challenge.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown through the campaign. Keep this separate from Catch Me If You Can: both refer to VCIA, but completing this named mission is not proof that you have met the other trophy's departure requirement.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: When Operation Savage Glory becomes available, save before starting and follow its objectives until the mission is complete. Check your trophy list afterward; the description gives no optional score or difficulty requirement to chase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the game's completion record, where available, to identify unfinished requirements, then cross-check those with this guide. Work by category and region rather than replaying already finished content; do not assume that 100% completion and all 55 trophies are the same checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: During exploration, note convenient stunt locations and keep track of which attempts actually advance your total. Use a safe approach with room to build speed and land, then check progress before repeating a route; the description does not confirm that repeating one stunt counts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Keep a short list of activity types you have tried and sample a new category whenever you pass one. Prioritize missing types over improving scores on familiar ones; consult the game's activity records, where available, before declaring a category done.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Practice one Shooting Range challenge at a time and compare your result with its gold target. Use the displayed scoring rules to decide whether accuracy or speed needs work, then move on only after gold is recorded; revisit every remaining challenge at the end.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Record the locations where you have won a Top Fun Drone Race. On a new course, learn the turns on an initial run and retry for first place; revisiting a location you have already won will not cover a missing location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Keep a list of race events you have won, aiming for a new event each time. Learn braking points before a serious attempt, then record the victory only after the result; repeated wins on one race do not satisfy twenty different races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal's fishing challenge and read its displayed win condition before choosing tackle or a fishing spot. Spend an attempt learning the controls and target, then adjust your approach to beat Cal rather than merely finishing a fishing session.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade game you can reliably play through and set aside time for a complete run. Follow that cabinet's own end condition rather than quitting after one round or a high score; the description asks for a completed game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Prioritize Andy when choosing side missions and keep notes on his last completed task. Return to his remaining contact or objective after each job, working toward his finale; count the finished strand toward Strangers & Freaks as well.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's side missions as a chain rather than treating the first job as completion. Note where the last task left you and check for his next objective after it; finish his finale and include the strand in your eight-strand tally.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's available tasks and record the most recent one so you can resume the chain after other activities. Finish his final mission before counting this strand toward Strangers & Freaks; individual jobs are not separate strands.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Maintain a tally of finished storylines, not individual side missions. Start with Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone to combine their finale trophies with this target, then complete three more stranger strands across Leonida.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Return to Randy's objectives between other side missions so his chain is not left half-finished. Track the last completed job, continue to his final mission, and count the completed storyline toward your eight stranger strands.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Keep Tyrone's tasks together in your notes so an unfinished chain is easy to resume. Follow any remaining objective for him through the final mission; finishing this strand also contributes to Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Sweep one region at a time and record each meditation spot you have used, not just visited. Interact at the spot before moving on; save a note or map reference for any location you cannot complete so the final sweep has a clear route.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Find Bret's hunting objective before hunting at random, then use any directions it provides to identify the unique animal. Prepare equipment before the hunt and follow the objective's instructions; the description does not establish a one-time availability window.
trophies.missable_note: Bret’s hunt for a unique animal may be a one-off, so complete it when he offers it before moving on to mop-up.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Choose three card sets to focus on and track their missing cards separately. Check your collection before retracing a route so you search for gaps rather than duplicates; three partial sets are not the same as three completed sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Keep a regional checklist of locations where you have used WAiNK It. Aim for new locations on each outing and verify the interaction completes before leaving; a hundred uses at one location would not establish a hundred locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Review the challenges you have available and start with targets close to completion. Combine compatible objectives in one outing, then record completed challenges rather than attempts; switch to another target if one repeatedly stalls.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, choose a durable vehicle and plan an escape route before drawing police attention. Reach four stars, then break pursuit and let the wanted level fully clear while still together; the description does not identify an online-only or one-off window.
trophies.missable_note: You need your partner with you when you lose the four-star Wanted Level, so earn this during the story before you ride alone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Scout a short route between three shops before starting with your partner. Keep a getaway vehicle nearby, complete the robberies consecutively, and avoid hiding long enough to clear your wanted level between stops; escape only after the third robbery.
trophies.missable_note: Rob three shops in a row while your partner is available and keep a manual save before the run in case you lose your Wanted Level and need to retry.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Vary the areas and vehicle types you investigate rather than repeatedly using familiar models. Keep a list or use discovery records where available, checking whether a new vehicle registers before spending time hunting another of the same type.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Choose an encounter with at least five enemies in reach, prepare a loaded weapon, and line up targets before activating Combat Focus. Avoid wasting the ability while repositioning: all five takedowns must fit inside the same activation.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Visit VCIA while exploring and inspect the available departure or vehicle interactions. Save before trying an escape so a failed experiment does not cost progress; the exact trigger behind “unscheduled departure” is not specified by the trophy list.
trophies.missable_note: Make the unscheduled departure during the story operation at VCIA, since you may need to replay it once the story moves on.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino wording is a clue, but the list supplies no exact action or location. Preserve a manual save before experimenting with a Rhino-related encounter and check the trophy result after each distinct attempt; a specific tank sequence is not verified here.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Scout the jewelry store before taking loot and look for a route that avoids staff and other detection risks. Make a manual save before trying, then reload or retry if detected instead of finishing a loud robbery and expecting the stealth requirement to count.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Plan an entry and getaway before opening a bank vault. Track five completed vault robberies with successful escapes, not just vaults reached; check that each attempt has concluded before starting the next.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Prepare a getaway vehicle and a route away from the armored truck before the robbery. Finish taking the loot and complete the escape rather than stopping as soon as the truck is opened; both parts are explicit requirements.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Work around Leonida region by region, checking the map for places you have not visited. Combine the sweep with meditation spots, WAiNK It locations and vehicle discovery, keeping a note of gaps to revisit instead of repeatedly crossing familiar roads.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Track gang names alongside successful operation robberies so you can see which gangs remain. Prioritize an operation belonging to a new gang over another target from one already covered; use ownership information when available to avoid guessing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach and look for a place to enjoy a cocktail overlooking the beach. Try the relevant drink interaction there and let it finish before checking your trophies; the list does not name a specific venue or view prompt.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: At a vehicle showroom, save before experimenting and look for a way to drive a vehicle out through the showroom. Plan your exit before attracting attention; the description suggests a smash-out but does not verify a scripted sequence or required vehicle.
trophies.missable_note: The showroom escape may be a one-off story event, so keep a manual save beforehand and smash your way out in classic style when it happens.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and inspect its available interactions. The description does not explain what “follow-through” means, so save before experimenting and check the trophy list after a completed interaction rather than assuming one throw is confirmed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: “A partnership with mass appeal” is the only unlock clue in the supplied list; it does not confirm an activity, online mode or location. Keep a save before partnership-related story decisions and note the context if this unlocks, rather than grinding an invented target.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Save to a separate slot before committing to each story choice. Check your trophies after the outcome; retain that save until this unlocks.
trophies.missable_note: Story choices can close off an outcome in “Choices made (for better or worse),” so keep a manual save before story choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The clue mentions a second time but does not identify the event or confirm a deliberate failure requirement. Save before experimenting with a suspected encounter and record the attempt sequence; do not sacrifice progress based on an assumed immediate-second-try counter.
trophies.missable_note: “Second time’s the charm” suggests the retry could be easy to miss, so see the encounter through to the second attempt if the first goes wrong.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This description gives no confirmed location, time or action. Keep a manual save before investigating an unusual encounter and note where and when it occurs; check the trophy list afterward instead of treating any particular observation trigger as verified.
trophies.missable_note: The strange event may only happen once, so stop and investigate when something unexplained happens in Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Choose a clear stretch of road and approach a target slowly enough to line up beside it. Use the available vehicle melee controls at close range, then check the result; a firearm drive-by would not meet the stated melee requirement.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Use your contacts to launder Marked Bills and record the amounts earned from completed transactions. Prioritize that income over unrelated cash sources for this target; aim for $250,000 earned through laundering rather than merely holding that much money.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Combine useful shop purchases with this spending target instead of buying filler immediately. Track your combined spending toward $100,000 and preserve enough money for garages; the requirement is spending across shops, not carrying that cash balance.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: List the garage properties you can purchase and compare prices with your available cash. Buy missing garages over duplicate or unrelated property investments, then check ownership after each purchase; save major spending for after you have budgeted the remaining garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Check the Scooter Bros app for registration instructions before sourcing vehicles. Take one eligible vehicle through the full registration process and confirm it is accepted before hunting the next; keep a tally of ten completed registrations.
